## Infiltration.adjectives() method

Returns a list of adjectives used in a particular minigame.

The list is randomized each time. If you have the augmentation Beauty of Aphrodite, then the positive adjectives will appear at the front of the list and only the negative adjectives will be randomized.

Requires API access.

**Signature:**

```typescript
adjectives(): string[];
```
**Returns:**

string\[\]
